findings.issue: IntentFilter(ACTION_SCREEN_ON, ACTION_SCREEN_OFF) is the (action, dataType) constructor. The second argument is parsed as a MIME type and throws MalformedMimeTypeException, so Engine.start() crashes on every arm and trips the crash-loop guard. JVM tests don't cover it.
findings.fix: val filter = IntentFilter().apply { addAction(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_ON); addAction(Intent.ACTION_SCREEN_OFF) }; ContextCompat.registerReceiver(ctx, screenRx, filter, null, engineHandler, ContextCompat.RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED)

findings.issue: The delete intent uses an implicit Intent(ACTION_NOTIF_DISMISSED) in PendingIntent.getService. startService rejects implicit service intents (API 21+), and Android 14 doesn't deliver implicit intents to non-exported components. The re-post never happens, so after a swipe the notification's 'Disable now' panic action is permanently gone.
findings.fix: PendingIntent.getService(ctx, 2, Intent(ctx, FocusService::class.java).setAction(ACTION_NOTIF_DISMISSED), FLAG_IMMUTABLE or FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT). Add a rule that every PendingIntent/startService Intent names its component explicitly, and add a grep audit for it in §16.

findings.issue: After a sticky restart degrades to SPECIAL_USE only (locationDegraded), the notification says 'Open FocusGate to resume location checks'. But MainActivity.onResume sends ACTION_START only when the service is not running, so the degraded service is never re-promoted and zone blocking stays fail-open until the next process death.
findings.fix: In MainActivity.onResume, when armed, send ACTION_START if !running || locationDegraded || ServiceTypes.compute(...) != currentTypes. ServiceStart with an existing engine calls startForeground with the full types: on success, clear locationDegraded, refresh the notification and tick; on SecurityException, stay degraded. Add a ServiceStartTest case. Add a §17 item to confirm on the device that a foreground re-call regains while-in-use location, falling back to stopService + startForegroundService from the activity.

findings.issue: The ungated non-data system calls (isLocationEnabled, isProviderEnabled, AppOps, BOOT_COUNT, isInteractive, PackageManager installed/label/launch-intent for the 3 apps) are not listed as a closed allow-list, but the spec says the gate is checked before every UsageStats/location call and the user said 'no app data while disabled'.
findings.fix: Add a 'Permitted while disarmed (no user data)' table to §10 with a reason for each call. Note that isProviderEnabled is called only inside the gated GpsSource.start. Grep-enforce the files where these calls may appear.

findings.issue: cursor_ts and armed_at_ts (tick-derived timestamps) persist after disarm. Engine.stop's final apply() on the engine thread can also race the UI's disarmed-only rollover write.
findings.fix: Engine.stop's final persist writes used_ms_* and day_key and removes cursor_ts and armed_at_ts in the same Editor. The UI's rollover write is allowed only when FocusService.engine == null. §12 marks these keys 'present only while armed'.

findings.issue: The 6 h replay runs in Engine.start() even when a sticky restart happens with the screen off, which contradicts 'nothing is queried while the screen is off'. openSince after the replay, and skipping an empty replay window, are unspecified.
findings.fix: Defer the replay to the first interactive tick (pendingReplay). Skip it when begin >= cursorTs. Set openSince = cursorTs for non-empty sets after the replay. Add tests.

findings.issue: cursorTs stays at the screen-off time, so a monitored RESUMED stamped during screen-off would accrue the off period (accrualFloor = cursorTs).
findings.fix: On ACTION_SCREEN_ON, set cursorTs = max(cursorTs, screenOnTs - 2000) without accruing, then tick with the usual queryBegin(). Add a test.

findings.issue: ACTION_TEST_BLOCK/ACTION_NOTIF_DISMISSED with no engine are 'ignored' with an unspecified return. A fresh instance lingers as a started, non-foreground service with service_alive = true, and its later kill counts toward the crash-loop guard.
findings.fix: Add the row: TEST_BLOCK/NOTIF_DISMISSED with no running engine → stopSelf(startId), START_NOT_STICKY, record no unclean restart. Add to ServiceStartTest.

findings.issue: Disarming while the Blocked screen is showing (for example panic from the notification shade) leaves the opaque Blocked screen up.
findings.fix: BlockedActivity collects ArmController.state and finish()es on Disarmed. Non-test mode also finishes if the gate is closed in onResume.

findings.issue: With no zones configured and 0 min left, the copy says 'location unclear', which is misleading.
findings.fix: In the per-app state mapping (decide unchanged): if zones.isEmpty(), show 'Time's up · no zones set, staying open'.

findings.issue: domain="root|file|database|sharedpref|external" is shorthand; taken literally the domain value is invalid.
findings.fix: Use one <exclude domain="X" path="."/> per domain (root, file, database, sharedpref, external) in full-backup-content. Use the same lines plus device_root/device_file/device_database/device_sharedpref inside both <cloud-backup> and <device-transfer>.

findings.issue: (a) gradle wrapper run inside an incomplete project fails at configuration. (b) The dependency allow-list may reject annotation-only artifacts such as org.jspecify. (c) ACTION_MANAGE_OVERLAY_PERMISSION ignores package: data on 11+. (d) The 'Test blocking after Recents swipe / screen-off' manual procedure is undefined, and the '(?)' after the vivo background-power component is ambiguous.
findings.fix: (a) Generate the wrapper in an empty temp directory and copy the files in. (b) Pass criterion: no gms/firebase/analytics/crash/ads groups, and list every other group in REPORT. (c) Copy: 'Find FocusGate in the list and turn it on'. (d) Steps: screen off/on (or Recents swipe), reopen FocusGate, start the test, switch app, wait ≥ 11 s; the definitive check is a real block after a Recents swipe. Drop the '(?)', since §17.1 covers it.
